author: Zintenka
body:
Reintroducing... an old Avicus map of mine... repurposed for Atlas!

-- Queuing awful attempt at Old English in a weird future! --

Thou must destroy the 3 pillars of Endstone rock! 75% of each being destroyed will suffice enough, this mission thou shalt partake in. Now. This is non-negotiable.

Alright, thou will be stationed upon a space dirigible and fight the opposing side for thine emperor's amusement. Dost thou understand the gravity of this situation? Yes? Good. Now go! Get out of mine sight!

                                                               ~~~~~~~~~~ BEHOLD! ~~~~~~~~~~~


Features:
  • Villager trading
  • Falling sand entity jack o lantern at front gives quick access to TNT but spawns every 20 seconds!
  • Mine ore to trade for currency
  • Get 2 nether star for each kill
  • Regeneration 1 and night vision as ambient effects
  • 3 large monuments on each side, depending upon it's gameplay and TNT mechanics I'll add haste when near them.
  • TNT earned from villager trades
  • Upgraded armor is earned from villagers
  • Everything bought from the store except for apples will save even after death; so don't you worry none ;)
Author:
  • Me! That's who! Charghan Egalitarium War Marshall Zintenka!
